types.title: Addition Worksheets
types.desc: Free printable addition worksheets with answer keys. Choose sums to 10, 20, 100 or 3-digit, set how many problems, then print or save as a PDF.
types.blurb: Printable addition practice you can generate on demand. Pick the number range that fits the grade — single-digit sums to 10 for early learners, up to 3-digit addition for older kids — set the problem count, and print. Every sheet comes with a matching answer key.
types.skill: Builds addition fluency from basic facts to multi-digit column addition. Sums to 10 and 20 suit Kindergarten through Grade 1; sums to 100 and 3-digit addition suit Grades 2–3.

types.title: Subtraction Worksheets
types.desc: Free printable subtraction worksheets with answer keys. Choose within 10, 20, 100 or 3-digit, set the problem count, then print or save as a PDF.
types.blurb: Printable subtraction practice with no negative answers — the larger number always comes first. Pick a number range, choose how many problems you want, and print a clean sheet plus its answer key.
types.skill: Practices take-away and difference facts. Within 10 and within 20 fit Kindergarten–Grade 1; within 100 and 3-digit subtraction fit Grades 2–3.

types.title: Multiplication Worksheets
types.desc: Free printable multiplication worksheets with answer keys. Practice facts 0–10, 0–12, or 2-digit × 1-digit, set the count, then print or save as a PDF.
types.blurb: Printable multiplication practice from basic facts to 2-digit × 1-digit. Choose the fact range, set how many problems, and print a worksheet with a matching answer key — great for daily drills.
types.skill: Builds multiplication fact fluency and multi-digit multiplication. Facts 0–10 and 0–12 fit Grades 2–4; 2-digit × 1-digit fits Grades 4–5.

types.title: Division Worksheets
types.desc: Free printable division worksheets with answer keys. Every problem divides evenly (no remainders). Choose the range, set the count, then print or save as a PDF.
types.blurb: Printable division practice where every problem divides evenly — no remainders to trip kids up. Pick the divisor and quotient range, set the problem count, and print with a full answer key.
types.skill: Practices division facts as the inverse of multiplication, with whole-number answers. Facts within 10 and 12 fit Grades 3–4; long-division-style 2-digit quotients fit Grades 4–5.

types.title: Mixed Operations Worksheets
types.desc: Free printable mixed math worksheets — addition, subtraction and multiplication together — with answer keys. Set the range and count, then print or save as a PDF.
types.blurb: Printable mixed-practice sheets that blend addition, subtraction and multiplication in one worksheet, so kids have to spot the operation before they solve. Pick a difficulty, set the count, and print with an answer key.
types.skill: Reinforces flexible recall across the three operations by mixing them on one page. The 'to 20' set fits Grades 2–3; 'to 100' fits Grades 3–5.

types.title: Times Tables Worksheets
types.desc: Free printable times tables worksheets with answer keys. Practice a single table 1–12 or a mixed set, set the count, then print or save as a PDF.
types.blurb: Printable times-table practice. Choose one table to drill — the 7 times table walks 7×1 through 7×12 in order — or a mixed set that jumps between tables. Set how many problems and print with a matching answer key.
types.skill: Cements multiplication tables 1–12 through focused, repeated practice. Ideal for Grades 2–4 memorizing facts one table at a time before mixing them.
